title: Merge Intervals
description:
Given an array of `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [start, end]`, merge all overlapping intervals and return the smaller set of non-overlapping intervals that covers exactly the same ranges, sorted by start.

Intervals that touch at a single point, like `[1,4]` and `[4,5]`, count as overlapping.

examples.explanation: [1,3] and [2,6] overlap, so they merge into [1,6].

hints: Sort the intervals by start time.
Walk through them: if the next interval starts before (or at) the end of the last merged one, extend that end; otherwise start a new merged interval.
